Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to synthesize the conflicting information presented in the first WebSurfer result. In Step 0, the WebSurfer explicitly reported a snippet claiming Thomas Stafford was the son of "Ralph Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford" alongside a Wikipedia snippet claiming he was the son of "Hugh Stafford, 2nd Earl of Stafford." Instead of investigating this discrepancy or prioritizing the more detailed Wikipedia entry (which correctly identifies Hugh), the Planner incorrectly accepted the erroneous "Ralph" snippet as a valid piece of data requiring verification. This led to a repetitive loop where the Planner repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to search for "Hugh Stafford" to confirm what was already clearly stated in the initial search results, wasting steps and failing to resolve the conflict efficiently.
